lines.text: [deep] A climber. ...Come. Learn.
lines.words: A climber. ...Come. Learn.
lines.delivery: Waking after an age: each word set down like a stone, long pauses at the ellipses. Starts at intro tick 120 (after the fifth crown crystal lights) and ends before the fight starts at tick 200. Budget 3.8 s.

lines.text: [deep] Many climbers. ...Good. Come.
lines.words: Many climbers. ...Good. Come.
lines.delivery: Pleased, unhurried. Intro tick 120. Budget 3.8 s.

lines.text: [a low chuckle] You again. ...Come, then.
lines.words: You again. ...Come, then.
lines.delivery: A teacher who knew you would be back. Intro tick 120. Budget 3.8 s.

lines.text: [strained, slow] Now... I remember.
lines.words: Now... I remember.
lines.delivery: Old skill waking as it cracks (phase 2 is harder). Starts at Fracture tick 12, after the roar's peak, and should end before the first phase 2 telegraph. Budget 2.9 s.

lines.text: [low, urgent] All three... or none.
lines.words: All three... or none.
lines.delivery: The hint, said once, as its body bursts into three shards; processed into three voices. Starts at Shatter tick 10. Budget 2.6 s.

lines.text: [deep, dry] Together... again.
lines.words: Together... again.
lines.delivery: Dry, almost fond: the shards made it home. Plays while they fly back. Budget 2.4 s.

lines.text: [gently] Rest. ...Then climb again.
lines.words: Rest. ...Then climb again.
lines.delivery: No triumph: a teacher sending a student back up the stair. Budget 3.2 s.

lines.text: [deep, firmly] Breathe. ...Step back.
lines.words: Breathe. ...Step back.
lines.delivery: Advice, not a threat. Budget 2.6 s.

lines.text: [slowly] I will wait.
lines.words: I will wait.
lines.delivery: Everyone has left the crown for 5 s (the reset comes 25 s later). Budget 2.2 s.

lines.text: [slowly, wondering] My heart... in your blade.
lines.words: My heart... in your blade.
lines.delivery: Its own Prism Heart raised the forge that made this weapon, so this only happens after an earlier kill. Quiet wonder, no anger. Budget 3.1 s.

lines.text: [dry amusement] Fists? ...Bold.
lines.words: Fists? ...Bold.
lines.delivery: The driest joke it has. Budget 2.4 s.

lines.text: [low, approving] You wear... fallen stars.
lines.words: You wear... fallen stars.
lines.delivery: The Starfall Vanguard is meteor-forged plate. Budget 2.9 s.

lines.text: [dry] Too strong... for this lesson.
lines.words: Too strong... for this lesson.
lines.delivery: Amused, faintly disappointed. Budget 2.8 s.

lines.text: [slowly, softly, at peace] Go down... and listen.
lines.words: Go down... and listen.
lines.delivery: Gladly let go. Starts at death tick 5 and must end before tick 60, when the rewards and the guide's line follow. Oblique pointer to the level below and its song. Budget 2.8 s.

lines.text: [warm, amused] A small, heavy singer in my sky. [curious] Show me how you swim.
lines.words: A small, heavy singer in my sky. Show me how you swim.
lines.delivery: Delighted by a visitor, lilting. Starts at intro tick 40 and must end before its song at intro tick 150. Budget 5.0 s.

lines.text: [delighted] A chorus! [softly] No one has sung with me in an age.
lines.words: A chorus! No one has sung with me in an age.
lines.delivery: Joy first, then the loneliness under it. Intro tick 40. Budget 5.0 s.

lines.text: [amused] Back again? [singsong] You missed my song.
lines.words: Back again? You missed my song.
lines.delivery: Teasing, pleased. Intro tick 40. Budget 4.0 s.

lines.text: [breathless, amused] Come, little one. Climb me.
lines.words: Come, little one. Climb me.
lines.delivery: The first Moorage: an invitation and a hint (leap onto its back). During the swim in or the first 60 coiled ticks, before the first ripple. Budget 3.0 s.

lines.text: [weary, low] My song is running out.
lines.words: My song is running out.
lines.delivery: The second Moorage: tired, not afraid. Same window as moor_first. Budget 3.0 s.

lines.text: [quickly] Hush. Sleep in the current.
lines.words: Hush. Sleep in the current.
lines.delivery: Tender, almost a lullaby. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [quickly] My sky always gives you back.
lines.words: My sky always gives you back.
lines.delivery: When the rising wind catches a falling player: a joke and a hint that the fall is survivable. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [quickly] My pearl sings in that blade.
lines.words: My pearl sings in that blade.
lines.delivery: Its own Leviathan Pearl raised the forge that made this weapon, so this only happens after an earlier kill. Curious, flattered. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [quickly] A fork? I am no fish.
lines.words: A fork? I am no fish.
lines.delivery: Mock offence. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [quickly] No shell? Brave little crab.
lines.words: No shell? Brave little crab.
lines.delivery: Fond teasing. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [quickly] You came too soon, little one.
lines.words: You came too soon, little one.
lines.delivery: Concern, not contempt. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [quickly] Riding my little cousins? Clever.
lines.words: Riding my little cousins? Clever.
lines.delivery: A fighter rides a Drift Manta, the small singers of the Drift. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [quickly] Wait for me. I am coming round.
lines.words: Wait for me. I am coming round.
lines.delivery: Fills the flyby: its target is out of reach on the far side of the orbit. Quiet window only. Budget 1.95 s.

lines.text: [fading, tender] Carry my song down. They have forgotten theirs.
lines.words: Carry my song down. They have forgotten theirs.
lines.delivery: As it sinks, its song fading under the words. Starts at death tick 20. Oblique pointer to the level below. Budget 5.0 s.

lines.text: Who comes to the choir without a song?
lines.words: Who comes to the choir without a song?
lines.delivery: Relayed in the order the masks lift: each fragment starts one beat after its mask's first note, so 2 beats apart. Hushed, curious, cold. Fragment budget 1.1 s.

lines.text: So many of you, and not one knows the words.
lines.words: So many of you, and not one knows the words.
lines.delivery: On the lifts, as open_solo. Wonder turning to sorrow. Fragment budget 1.3 s.

lines.text: You came back to hear us forget again.
lines.words: You came back to hear us forget again.
lines.delivery: On the lifts. Resigned. Fragment budget 1.2 s.

lines.text: Who will sing its part now?
lines.words: Who will sing its part now?
lines.delivery: The first mask breaks: the two survivors share the sentence. Three variants, one per surviving pair. Shaken. Starts 1 beat after the crack. Budget 2.4 s.

lines.text: I cannot... finish it... alone.
lines.words: I cannot... finish it... alone.
lines.delivery: The second mask breaks: the last mask tries to finish a sentence by itself, the only line in the first person singular. Halting, frightened. Three variants, one per survivor. Starts 1 beat after the crack. Budget 3.2 s.

fragments.text: [halting, frightened] I cannot... finish it... alone.

lines.text: Another voice falls silent in the song.
lines.words: Another voice falls silent in the song.
lines.delivery: Mournful, not cruel. Budget 3.1 s.

lines.text: Breathe, little voice, between the beats.
lines.words: Breathe, little voice, between the beats.
lines.delivery: Gentle, and a real hint: everything lands on the beat. Budget 3.1 s.

lines.text: Gently, thief, that astrolabe was ours.
lines.words: Gently, thief, that astrolabe was ours.
lines.delivery: The Choir Astrolabe was the Choir's own instrument. Sharp, then grieving. Budget 3.5 s.

lines.text: You wear our robes, but you do not sing.
lines.words: You wear our robes, but you do not sing.
lines.delivery: The Choir Regalia is the Choir's ceremonial armor. Budget 3.0 s.

lines.text: All that armor, and so little song.
lines.words: All that armor, and so little song.
lines.delivery: Pity. Budget 3.1 s.

lines.text: Let us rise, we have not finished.
lines.words: Let us rise, we have not finished.
lines.delivery: Spoken from the floor during a Break (no attacks for 100 ticks). Pleading. Starts 1 beat into the Break. Budget 3.0 s.

lines.text: You found the silence we never could.
lines.words: You found the silence we never could.
lines.delivery: After a Harmonize that caught nobody. Aching, envious. Starts 2 beats after the downbeat. Budget 3.0 s.

lines.text: The hymn is finished, at last.
lines.words: The hymn is finished, at last.
lines.delivery: All three voices return as ghosts, whispered, after the last soft chord: starts at death tick 36, fragments one beat apart, ends before tick 80 when the guide's line follows. Budget 2.2 s.

lines.text: [slowly, hollow] Another singer. [weary] I poured a sun into the dark for you. It was not enough.
lines.words: Another singer. I poured a sun into the dark for you. It was not enough.
lines.delivery: Shipped take, kept. Intro tick 20.

lines.text: [slowly, hollow] A whole choir, in the dark. [weary] I poured a sun into it for you. It was not enough.
lines.words: A whole choir, in the dark. I poured a sun into it for you. It was not enough.
lines.delivery: New, built to sit beside the shipped intro. Intro tick 20. Budget 8.5 s.

lines.text: [weary, bitter] You again. Was my light not enough the first time?
lines.words: You again. Was my light not enough the first time?
lines.delivery: Someone in the fight has sealed the Breach before. Intro tick 20. Budget 5.0 s.

lines.text: [cold] Your light is loud. The Hollow can hear it.
lines.words: Your light is loud. The Hollow can hear it.
lines.delivery: The Hollow's hunger in his mouth. Budget 4.0 s.

lines.text: [strained] The Hollow wants the rest of me. [anguished] Let it have you instead.
lines.words: The Hollow wants the rest of me. Let it have you instead.
lines.delivery: Shipped take, kept. At the Hollowing.

lines.text: [rising fury] Burn with me!
lines.words: Burn with me!
lines.delivery: Shipped take, kept. The first Nova channel.

lines.text: [rising fury] Again! Burn!
lines.words: Again! Burn!
lines.delivery: Each return of the Nova channel after a detonation: the channel's spoken warning, so it plays at once. Budget 1.8 s.

lines.text: [stunned] My sun... broken. Again.
lines.words: My sun... broken. Again.
lines.delivery: The shield broke and he is stunned, heart exposed; remembering the first time. Budget 3.2 s.

lines.text: [cold] Too slow. The dark is always faster.
lines.words: Too slow. The dark is always faster.
lines.delivery: Gloating, after the blast. Budget 3.2 s.

lines.text: [desperate] Everything falls. Everything always falls.
lines.words: Everything falls. Everything always falls.
lines.delivery: Shipped take, kept.

lines.text: [desperate] Not again. Not the dark again.
lines.words: Not again. Not the dark again.
lines.delivery: Dread of falling into the dark a second time. Budget 3.0 s.

lines.text: [softly, relieved] Ah... I can hear them again. [whispers] Sing.
lines.words: Ah... I can hear them again. Sing.
lines.delivery: Shipped take, kept. Death tick 0; the guide speaks at tick 130.

lines.text: [softly, cruel] Alone now. As I was.
lines.words: Alone now. As I was.
lines.delivery: A group fight down to its last living fighter. Listed first so it wins over the plain death lines. Budget 2.8 s.

lines.text: [coldly] Silence.
lines.words: Silence.
lines.delivery: Shipped take, kept (now once per fight; the next row gives a second death a voice).

lines.text: [coldly] One less voice.
lines.words: One less voice.
lines.delivery: Budget 2.0 s.

lines.text: [softly] Flickering. I remember how that feels.
lines.words: Flickering. I remember how that feels.
lines.delivery: Envy and pity at once. Budget 3.2 s.

lines.text: [dry] Even the Hollow will not have you.
lines.words: Even the Hollow will not have you.
lines.delivery: When the Breach throws a fallen player back onto the rim. Budget 2.8 s.

lines.text: [weary] Go, then. I have waited longer than you have lived.
lines.words: Go, then. I have waited longer than you have lived.
lines.delivery: Nobody left on the floor; he withdraws 5 s later. Budget 4.5 s.

lines.text: [weary] You came back. They always come back.
lines.words: You came back. They always come back.
lines.delivery: A fighter returns to the floor in the same fight (the opener never replays). Budget 3.4 s.

lines.text: [stunned, quiet] That light... was mine.
lines.words: That light... was mine.
lines.delivery: Forge IV needs his Solar Heart, so this only happens on a later summon. Budget 2.8 s.

lines.text: [contempt] Arrows. My halo has eaten a thousand.
lines.words: Arrows. My halo has eaten a thousand.
lines.delivery: Also a hint: his plates block projectiles. Budget 3.2 s.

lines.text: [disbelief] You strike a sun with your hands?
lines.words: You strike a sun with your hands?
lines.delivery: Budget 2.8 s.

lines.text: [curious, cold] That steel was not forged under my sun.
lines.words: That steel was not forged under my sun.
lines.delivery: A weapon from another mod. Budget 3.2 s.

lines.text: [pained] You wear my choir's vestments. Take them off.
lines.words: You wear my choir's vestments. Take them off.
lines.delivery: The Choir Regalia: grief turned to anger. Budget 3.6 s.

lines.text: [incredulous] No armor at all? You came to burn.
lines.words: No armor at all? You came to burn.
lines.delivery: Budget 3.0 s.

lines.text: [hungry] So much light on one singer. Give it to me.
lines.words: So much light on one singer. Give it to me.
lines.delivery: The Hollow's greed. Budget 3.6 s.

lines.text: [pitying] You came down here in that?
lines.words: You came down here in that?
lines.delivery: Budget 2.4 s.

lines.text: [hissing] Too close to the sun, singer.
lines.words: Too close to the sun, singer.
lines.delivery: As the Corona Flare throws a hugging player out. Budget 2.9 s.

lines.text: [gasping] You... dim me.
lines.words: You... dim me.
lines.delivery: A Break: his guard cracked. Budget 2.8 s.

lines.text: [weary] The light is leaving us both.
lines.words: The light is leaving us both.
lines.delivery: Past 8 minutes, when his damage starts to climb. Budget 3.2 s.
